title: eugenia formosa var. ternifolia
intro: Eugenia formosa var. ternifolia, commonly known as Philippine rain tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Eugenia formosa var. ternifolia include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
